agree.title: Record that both sides agreed
agree.lead: Did the buyer and the seller both accept exactly the price and conditions below? Record how each side told you. The deal then moves to its next steps.
agree.tenantLead: Did the tenant and the landlord both accept exactly the rent and conditions below? Record how each side told you. The deal then moves to its next steps.
agree.ownAnswer: The seller has to accept in the client area. You can record the buyer's side now.
agree.done: Both sides agreed to these terms.
agree.changedTerms: These terms changed after someone accepted them. Each side needs to accept the new terms.

home.title: Add a home to this deal
home.lead: Pick any home the agency holds, published or not. It goes straight onto the client's shortlist.
home.reason: Why it fits, in one line
home.submit: Add a home to this deal
home.none: No homes are available for this kind of deal. Add a listing first, then come back.

proposal.nameHint: Only if they are not in the list above. We keep the name on this property.
proposal.noOwner: The agency has no seller recorded for this home yet. We keep the name on this property.

errors.identity_checks_first: Record the identity checks first. Deposits, contracts, the deed and the keys come after them.
errors.duty_in_scope: This step is required for this deal, so it cannot be marked as not needed. Mark it done once it has happened.
errors.counterparty_must_answer: The seller has to accept in the client area. Ask them to sign in and accept, then record the buyer's side.
errors.listing_unavailable: This home is sold, let or withdrawn, so it cannot be added or offered. Choose another home.
errors.missingSide: Choose how this side said yes and the date.
errors.sellerMissing: Choose who is selling, or type their name.
